name: @atlasauth/pca-webbotauth
description: Web Bot Auth for PCA (RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures): sign outbound agent HTTP requests with an Ed25519 key published at /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory, optionally carrying the PCA per-action proof, so PCA agents pass Cloudflare/AWS-WAF bot verification AND carry proof-of-authority.
